qa_pairs.question: What is the resistance value for the revolution number converter (trasduttore numero di giri) for isolation resistance?
qa_pairs.answer: maggiore di 1 M Ω (greater than 1 M Ω)

qa_pairs.question: What resistance range is specified for the temperature-dependent coolant temperature sensor at 15°C to 30°C?
What is the resistance value for the coolant temperature sensor at 80°C?
What resistance specification is given for the reference signal converter (trasduttore segno di riferimento) for isolation resistance?
What are the resistance ranges specified for the revolution number converter and winding signal converter?
What is the minimum resistance specification for switching carburetor variations?
qa_pairs.answer: minore di 10 Ω (less than 10 Ω) and maggiore di 1 M Ω (greater than 1 M Ω)

qa_pairs.question: What test condition is specified for the accelerator pedal position switch in the idle position?
qa_pairs.answer: Pedale acceleratore in posizione di riposo; Tenere leggermente il pedale acceleratore (Accelerator pedal in rest position; Hold the accelerator pedal lightly)

qa_pairs.question: What resistance value is specified for the mass contact cables?
qa_pairs.answer: ogni volta minore di 10 Ω (each time less than 10 Ω)

qa_pairs.question: What voltage is mentioned for the flat battery connection in the test setup?
qa_pairs.answer: 1,5 V per il fermo della miscela povera (1.5 V for lean mixture stop)

qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of disconnecting the gear and removing the ignition according to the test instructions?
qa_pairs.answer: Disinnestare la marcia. Disinserire l'accensione. Sfilare la centralina elettronica e il relè principale (Disengage the gear. Turn off the ignition. Remove the electronic control unit and the main relay)
